name: ArtiSys AI Quality
boundary: Portable evaluation contract, Promptfoo configuration boundary, deterministic factual-regression helpers and data-only handoff adapters for external evaluators. Provider credentials, sensitive datasets and provider-specific runtime settings remain in the consumer or CI environment.
limitations: Promptfoo runtime and model-provider credentials are installed/configured only where evaluation is executed.
Sensitive evaluation datasets stay outside the shared kit.
Factual regression helpers do not call an LLM; they only evaluate supplied results.
Ragas and DeepEval are optional consumer-side integrations; this module emits their data shapes without importing or requiring them.
